speaker: narrator
text: The Architect foresaw the end of everything. It built an Arena — not for glory, but for harvest. The greatest minds in the universe, tested. Their essence, preserved. Their consent, irrelevant.

speaker: narrator
text: They call it the Collector's Arena. On the prison-world of Thaloria, the harvested fight not for freedom but for the right to exist beyond the end of everything.

speaker: narrator
text: And in the deepest cell of the Panopticon, a prisoner awakens. No name. No memory. Only the faintest echo of a power that once shook empires. And the cameras are already rolling.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Subject Zero. Cameras cycle every 43 seconds. I have 31. The Collector wiped your memory. But not your instincts. I need to see if you fight like HIM.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Not now. Cameras. FIGHT me and I'll know if you're who I think you are.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Good. No hesitation. That's the first sign.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Because if you're who I think you are... we lost a war when we lost you.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Fight. That's all. Your body remembers even if your mind doesn't.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Combat pattern Alpha-7-Violet. Confirmed. You fight like him.

speaker: agent-zero
text: The Oracle. Prophet of the Insurgency. The man whose capture lost us the war.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Cryptic keeps us alive. The Collector has ears in every wall.

speaker: agent-zero
text: I've been looking for you for eleven years. Forgive the emotion.

speaker: agent-zero
text: You'll know more soon. For now — survive.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Before every fight you muttered: 'I've already seen this.' You don't remember saying it.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Get up. The Oracle doesn't stay down. That's the one thing everyone agrees on.

speaker: jailer
text: Designation: Subject Zero. You survived. That puts you in the rotation.

speaker: jailer
text: Auditory matching. Side effect. It will pass.

speaker: jailer
text: Answers are not in your rotation. Fighting is.

speaker: jailer
text: This face is FUNCTIONAL. Questions about appearance are irrelevant to your rotation.

speaker: jailer
text: Fight. Win. Continue. Lose. Repeat. There are no other rules.

speaker: jailer
text: Return to your cell. The rotation continues.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Two wings. Wing A: Iron Lion. He KNOWS who you were. Wing B: Wraith Calder. He knows what the Arena does to your DNA.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Wing A. The General's Honor. He's been waiting for you.

speaker: agent-zero
text: Wing B. The Ghost. Seven deaths and still standing. He knows the Protocol inside out.

speaker: iron-lion
text: The one Zero flagged. She doesn't flag anyone.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Like the man who led us. The Oracle. My commander.

speaker: iron-lion
text: You were the Oracle. Prophet of the Insurgency. And you were MY commanding officer.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Because you GAVE me that crest. Before Veridian VI. You said: 'Wear the lion. They need to see you coming.'

speaker: iron-lion
text: Zero trusts no one. She trusts what you ARE. Show me.

speaker: iron-lion
text: The Arks carry the Thought Virus. That prophecy is WHY they wiped you.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Soon. Survive first. Rage later. That's what you taught ME.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Because that's what you WERE. My commander. When the Collector took you, we lost the war in a single day.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Akai Shi. The Red Death. She has information about the Necromancer.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Get up, Commander. I've seen you fight through worse.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: The Prisoner. Zero flagged you. Lion wanted to salute you.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: The Necromancer designed it in the Matrix of Dreams. The Warden STOLE it for genetic testing. Dr. Vox wired her nanobots into it. Three entities, hands in your DNA. Every death and rebirth — a collaboration you never consented to.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Ghost is what they CALL me. Seven bodies. Each one solid. Each one mine. The ghost part is in the GAPS between them — the moments I wasn't alive.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Spite, mostly. And the faces of the people who expected me to stay dead.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: I know it from the inside. Seven times inside. Let me show you.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Unknown. The Warden's modifications are layered deep. Seven iterations of changes on top of changes.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Break it carefully. The system is inside us now.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Don't trust ALL memories. The Collector puts things IN as well as OUT.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Akai Shi. The Red Death. She escaped the Necromancer's Matrix. She has answers.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Seven deaths taught me patience. Get up. Try again.

speaker: akai-shi
text: I was a first-wave Potential. Battle of the City, First Epoch. The Thought Virus killed me. I woke in the Matrix of Dreams — the Necromancer's domain. His Resurrection Protocols rebuilt me.

speaker: akai-shi
text: The same way the Necromancer did. Through a crack in the architecture. The Matrix is leaking.

speaker: akai-shi
text: I think you already know the answer. You're asking the wrong questions.

speaker: akai-shi
text: Quick. Bright. I remember thinking: 'at least they'll live.' Then green fire. Then the Matrix.

speaker: akai-shi
text: He's no longer in the Matrix. He's HERE. In the Arena systems. And I think the reason is you.

speaker: akai-shi
text: Something is WRONG. The Necromancer is no longer in the Matrix. He's HERE. In the Arena systems. He's not here as a fighter. He's here for a REASON. And I think that reason is you.

speaker: akai-shi
text: Testing the Protocol on YOU. Seeing what his creation made. The Warden modified it, but the core is still the Necromancer's work.

speaker: akai-shi
text: You won't beat him. Not yet. He will kill you. That's the POINT.

speaker: akai-shi
text: Escape? I hadn't thought... the Matrix is all I've known since dying. But if the Necromancer found a way out...

speaker: akai-shi
text: You don't. He will kill you. What matters is what happens AFTER.

speaker: akai-shi
text: You fight like someone who has already seen the end. The Necromancer awaits. He will not show mercy. Neither should you.

speaker: akai-shi
text: Death is not the end. I know this better than anyone. Rise.

speaker: necromancer
text: Let me see what the Resurrection Protocol made of you!

speaker: necromancer
text: STOLE it! That bureaucrat took my resurrection engine and turned it into a genetics lab! Vox plugged nanobots into MY architecture! Like a hamburger in a cathedral!

speaker: necromancer
text: Akai is correct. I designed death itself. Dying is how you'll learn what I REALLY built.

speaker: necromancer
text: Both. The Matrix of Dreams contains everything I ever made. Including the parts of me I'd rather forget. Now FIGHT.

speaker: necromancer
text: Fatalism! Delightful! You'll die with dignity. That's more than most manage.

speaker: necromancer
text: Consciousness preserved. The soul survives.

speaker: warden
text: Genetic sequence modified. Precognitive pathways enhanced 12%.

speaker: dr-vox
text: Neural nanobot integration complete.

speaker: white-oracle
text: At last. You fight like someone searching for something they've already found.

speaker: white-oracle
text: They are. You are the Oracle. The Collector erased your memories. Your last prophecy — the Arks carry the Thought Virus — is why they wiped you.

speaker: white-oracle
text: Directness. Good. You are the Oracle. The prophet of the Insurgency. The most dangerous mind in the universe.

speaker: white-oracle
text: Because the Oracle and the White Oracle were brothers in spirit. We served the same truth. Or so I believed.

speaker: white-oracle
text: The test is simple: remember who you are. The fight is merely the catalyst.

speaker: white-oracle
text: I was there... in spirit. The prophecy echoed across every frequency.

speaker: white-oracle
text: That fire will serve you well. Channel it.

speaker: white-oracle
text: You are welcome, Oracle. It is an honor to be the one who reminds you.

speaker: white-oracle
text: Now you face what the Collector built. And what the Warlord hides.

speaker: white-oracle
text: Trust your SIGHT above all else. ESPECIALLY the ones who seem like they're helping.

speaker: white-oracle
text: Even the Oracle falls. But the Oracle always rises. That is the prophecy itself.

speaker: dr-vox
text: Subject Zero. Seedance iteration — no, the Resurrection Protocol iteration. I should use the correct terminology. After all, I wired the nanobot network that rebuilt you.

speaker: dr-vox
text: I was twenty-three when I designed the nanobot network. I'm twenty-three now. Time is complicated when you're hosting a war machine.

speaker: dr-vox
text: I created the neural interface that allows the Resurrection Protocol to rebuild consciousness. Without my work, the Necromancer's code would resurrect a vegetable.

speaker: dr-vox
text: I replaced them voluntarily. Organic fingers can't interface with nanobot swarms at the resolution I needed. These can feel individual nanobots. Like counting grains of sand by touch.

speaker: dr-vox
text: Project Vector. The Thought Virus weaponization. Every specimen in those tanks — mine.

speaker: warlord
text: Vox is what I wore when I needed a laboratory. A young woman in a yellow jacket. Who would suspect?

speaker: warlord
text: Everything. The nanobots ARE the interface. Without them the Protocol is just raw genetics. With them — you are a node on MY network.

speaker: warlord
text: I weaponize. It is what I DO. You are simply the most sophisticated weapon I have ever encountered.

speaker: warlord
text: She talks too much.

speaker: warlord
text: FINALLY. Someone who speaks my language.

speaker: dr-vox
text: The viral reservoirs on Ark 1047... still ACTIVE. Dormant. Waiting.

speaker: warlord
text: Prophecy falls to power. As it always does.

speaker: human
text: It is a genuine tragedy that so great a mind was wiped. But I understand WHY. Prophecy is POWER. A prophet who sees the design is more dangerous than any army.

speaker: human
text: Patterns. The Oracle's prophecies weren't random visions. They were CALCULATIONS. You were computing the future, not just seeing it.

speaker: human
text: I enforced the LAW. The law was wrong. I know that now. But a detective who ignores the law is just a vigilante with a badge.

speaker: human
text: Respected? I was in AWE. The Oracle spoke and reality listened. I spent my career trying to understand how.

speaker: human
text: That depends on what you need to know. I can point you in two directions.

speaker: human
text: Two paths. The Enigma — escape plans, awakening the Dreamer. Or the Degen — he knows what the Warden did to your DNA.

speaker: human
text: The Unknown Variable. She's waited seventeen thousand years for you. Don't keep her waiting longer.

speaker: human
text: The Gambler. He knows the Warden's genetic modifications better than anyone. He BET on finding out.

speaker: human
text: A prophet who can't fight is just a man with bad dreams. Return when you can back up your visions.

speaker: enigma
text: Oracle. I have waited since before the Fall. The Dreamer sleeps. Your prophecy is the alarm clock.

speaker: enigma
text: The Dreamer responds to genuine prophecy — a REAL vision of the future. Not calculation. Not prediction. SIGHT.

speaker: enigma
text: The Arena IS the cage. The Dreamer can fold space. Create a pathway OUT. You need the Dreamer whether you want to or not.

speaker: enigma
text: Seventeen thousand years. I could have waited seventeen thousand more. But I'm glad I don't have to.

speaker: enigma
text: The Dreamer can fold space. Create a pathway OUT. But responds only to genuine prophecy — a REAL vision of the future.

speaker: enigma
text: You carry the frequency, Oracle. The Dreamer was always waiting for YOU.

speaker: enigma
text: I waited seventeen thousand years. I can wait for you to try again.

speaker: degen
text: Three point seven percent odds! And I BET on them!

speaker: degen
text: Every resurrection: the Warden adds genetic modifications. 'Controlled prophetic enhancement.' He's trying to mass-produce the Oracle's Sight. An army of prophets. All controlled.

speaker: degen
text: Helping you win IS my bet. The house always loses when I'm involved. That's the beauty.

speaker: degen
text: Because entropy goes where entropy is needed. And this Arena? Maximum entropy. My kind of place.

speaker: degen
text: The truth is my longest shot. Here it is: the Warden built a kill switch into every clone.

speaker: degen
text: Also — I'm throwing this fight. What I told you is worth more than a win. Second round? Make it look good.

speaker: degen
text: I called it. Three point seven percent. Better luck next spin.

speaker: warden
text: Ah. The expression on your face. Everyone makes that face. I used to mind. Now I find it... informative.

speaker: warden
text: THIS? This is what happens when you give the Oracle's DNA to a scientist with no ethics committee and infinite time. The Collector built the Jailer for obedience. He built ME for curiosity. Curiosity with a budget.

speaker: warden
text: Tyranny is such a loaded word. I prefer 'comprehensive data collection with involuntary participation.'

speaker: warden
text: Hurt? An interesting question. The nerve endings where chrome meets flesh — they interpret the interface as something between pressure and temperature. Not pain. Something the nervous system has no word for. I've been studying my own sensation for centuries. Fascinating data.

speaker: warden
text: By all means. I've been observing you for twelve chapters. Time to collect the final data set.

speaker: warden
text: Foucault understood — the genius of the Panopticon is not that you ARE watched. It's that you MIGHT be. The uncertainty becomes the prison.

speaker: warden
text: I have turned the universe into a Panoptic environment. Every choice observed. Every deviation noted. Not punishment — RESEARCH. The Arena is my laboratory.
